plans.rootCause: The all-args constructor of TaskDTO takes 8 parameters, exceeding the 7-parameter threshold, reducing readability and maintainability.
plans.remediationIntent: Reduce constructor parameter count by removing the redundant all-args constructor and relying on the existing no-arg constructor plus setters (already present and used for JSON binding), since no other code path requires the 8-arg constructor given the supplied source context.
requiredChanges: Remove the 8-parameter constructor from TaskDTO.java, keeping only the existing no-arg constructor.

Verify no other source file in the repository invokes the removed 8-arg constructor before removing it; if such usages exist outside the supplied snapshot, convert them to use the no-arg constructor plus setters instead.
Preserve all existing fields, getters, setters, and the statusPresent tracking logic unchanged.
forbiddenChanges: Do not introduce a builder pattern or parameter object unless verified against existing project conventions not present in supplied context.
Do not change field types, status representation, or DTO/persistence decoupling.
Do not alter the no-arg constructor or setter behavior.
expectedBehaviorPreserved: TaskDTO remains fully constructible via no-arg constructor and setters.
All getters/setters continue to function identically.

validationStrategy.scanner: Re-run SonarQube java:S107 check on TaskDTO.java to confirm the constructor parameter-count violation is resolved.
